de.name: Casa Real
de.text: Die historischen Ruinen eines ehemaligen spanischen kolonialen Verwaltungsgebäudes in der Nähe des Cagayan River.

de.name: San Pablo Church
de.text: Die imposanten Ruinen einer alten Ziegelkirche aus der spanischen Kolonialzeit in der Nähe des Cagayan River.

de.name: CBCC
de.text: Dieses lokale Gotteshaus dient der Gemeinde in der Nähe der Ufer des Cagayan-Flusses.

de.name: Ang Dating Daan
de.text: Dieses religiöse Zentrum gehört der auf den Philippinen ansässigen christlichen Konfession Ang Dating Daan an.

de.name: Our Lady of Snow's Parish Church
de.text: Diese der Marienverehrung geweihte katholische Pfarrkirche dient als spiritueller Treffpunkt in der Cagayan-Flussregion.

de.name: Sta Maria Catholic Church
de.text: Diese traditionelle katholische Kirche bietet der örtlichen Pfarrgemeinde einen ruhigen Ort zum Beten.

de.name: Minanga Chapel
de.text: Diese kleine christliche Kapelle bietet religiöse Gottesdienste für die Bewohner des örtlichen Flussdorfes an.

de.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
de.text: Dieses moderne Gemeindehaus gehört der im Cagayan-Tal ansässigen mormonischen Gemeinde.

de.name: United Methodist Church
de.text: Dieses protestantische Gotteshaus veranstaltet Sonntagsgottesdienste und Gemeindetreffen für die örtliche methodistische Gemeinde.

de.name: Saint Paul the Apostle Parish church
de.text: Diese große, dem Apostel Paulus geweihte Pfarrkirche ist ein Mittelpunkt des katholischen Glaubens in der Region.

de.name: Cabagan Baptist church
de.text: Diese Baptistenkirche dient als Zentrum für biblische Lehren und Gemeinschaft in der Gemeinde Cabagan.

de.name: Catabayungan Ermita Church Cabagan
de.text: Diese christliche Kapelle im historischen Stil, bekannt als Ermita, bietet eine rustikale Umgebung für ruhige Kontemplation in Cabagan.

de.name: Casibarag Norte Chapel
de.text: Diese lokale christliche Kapelle dient dem Viertel Casibarag Norte und ist ein wichtiger spiritueller Treffpunkt für die Anwohner.

de.name: Cabagan Public Market
de.text: Ein lebendiges Handelszentrum in Cabagan, in dem Verkäufer eine Vielzahl lokaler landwirtschaftlicher Güter und Fleischwaren anbieten.

hu.name: Casa Real
hu.text: Egy egykori spanyol gyarmati közigazgatási épület történelmi romjai a Cagayan folyó közelében.

hu.name: San Pablo Church
hu.text: Egy régi spanyol kori tégla templom impozáns romjai a Cagayan folyó közelében.

hu.name: CBCC
hu.text: Ez a helyi imaház a Cagayan-folyó partjának közelében lévő közösséget szolgálja.

hu.name: Ang Dating Daan
hu.text: Ez a vallási központ a Fülöp-szigeteki alapítású Ang Dating Daan keresztény felekezethez tartozik.

hu.name: Our Lady of Snow's Parish Church
hu.text: Ez a Mária-tiszteletnek szentelt katolikus plébániatemplom spirituális gyülekezőhelyként szolgál a Cagayan-folyó régiójában.

hu.name: Sta Maria Catholic Church
hu.text: Ez a hagyományos katolikus templom csendes teret biztosít az imádkozáshoz a helyi egyházközség számára.

hu.name: Minanga Chapel
hu.text: Ez a kis keresztény kápolna vallási szolgáltatásokat nyújt a helyi folyóparti falu lakóinak.

hu.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
hu.text: Ez a modern gyülekezeti ház a Cagayan-völgyben letelepedett mormon közösséghez tartozik.

hu.name: United Methodist Church
hu.text: Ez a protestáns imaház vasárnapi istentiszteleteknek és közösségi összejöveteleknek ad otthont a helyi metodista gyülekezet számára.

hu.name: Saint Paul the Apostle Parish church
hu.text: Ez a Pál apostolnak szentelt nagy plébániatemplom a katolikus hit központja a régióban.

hu.name: Cabagan Baptist church
hu.text: Ez a baptista templom a bibliai tanítások és a közösség központjaként szolgál Cabagan községben.

hu.name: Catabayungan Ermita Church Cabagan
hu.text: Ez a történelmi stílusú, ermita néven ismert keresztény kápolna rusztikus környezetet kínál a csendes elmélkedéshez Cabaganban.

hu.name: Casibarag Norte Chapel
hu.text: A Casibarag Norte negyedet szolgáló helyi keresztény kápolna a környékbeli lakosok fontos spirituális gyülekezőhelye.

hu.name: Cabagan Public Market
hu.text: Élénk kereskedelmi központ Cabaganban, ahol az árusok különféle helyi mezőgazdasági termékeket és húsokat árulnak.

ro.name: Casa Real
ro.text: Ruinele istorice ale unei foste clădiri administrative coloniale spaniole de lângă râul Cagayan.

ro.name: San Pablo Church
ro.text: Ruinele impunătoare ale unei vechi biserici din cărămidă din epoca spaniolă, situate în apropierea râului Cagayan.

ro.name: CBCC
ro.text: Acest lăcaș de cult local deservește comunitatea aflată în apropierea malurilor râului Cagayan.

ro.name: Ang Dating Daan
ro.text: Acest centru religios aparține confesiunii creștine filipineze Ang Dating Daan.

ro.name: Our Lady of Snow's Parish Church
ro.text: Dedicată devoțiunii mariane, această biserică parohială catolică servește drept loc de adunare spirituală în regiunea râului Cagayan.

ro.name: Sta Maria Catholic Church
ro.text: Această biserică catolică tradițională oferă un spațiu liniștit pentru rugăciune comunității parohiale locale.

ro.name: Minanga Chapel
ro.text: Această mică capelă creștină oferă servicii religioase locuitorilor satului de pe malul râului.

ro.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
ro.text: Această casă de adunare modernă aparține comunității mormone stabilite în Valea Cagayan.

ro.name: United Methodist Church
ro.text: Acest lăcaș de cult protestant găzduiește slujbe duminicale și adunări comunitare pentru congregația metodistă locală.

ro.name: Saint Paul the Apostle Parish church
ro.text: Dedicată Apostolului Pavel, această mare biserică parohială este un punct focal al credinței catolice din regiune.

ro.name: Cabagan Baptist church
ro.text: Această biserică baptistă servește drept centru pentru învățături biblice și părtășie în municipalitatea Cabagan.

ro.name: Catabayungan Ermita Church Cabagan
ro.text: Această capelă creștină în stil istoric, cunoscută sub numele de ermita, oferă un cadru rustic pentru contemplare liniștită în Cabagan.

ro.name: Casibarag Norte Chapel
ro.text: Deservind cartierul Casibarag Norte, această capelă creștină locală este un spațiu cheie de adunare spirituală pentru locuitorii din apropiere.

ro.name: Cabagan Public Market
ro.text: Un centru comercial plin de viață din Cabagan, unde vânzătorii oferă o varietate de bunuri agricole locale și carne.

en.name: Casa Real

en.name: San Pablo Church
en.text: The imposing ruins of an old Spanish-era brick church located near the Cagayan River.

en.name: CBCC
en.text: This local place of worship serves the community near the banks of the Cagayan River.

en.name: Ang Dating Daan
en.text: This religious center belongs to the Philippine-based Christian denomination, Ang Dating Daan.

en.name: Our Lady of Snow's Parish Church
en.text: Dedicated to the Marian devotion, this Catholic parish church serves as a spiritual gathering place in the Cagayan River region.

en.name: Sta Maria Catholic Church
en.text: This traditional Catholic church provides a quiet space for prayer for the local parish community.

en.name: Minanga Chapel
en.text: This small Christian chapel offers religious services to the residents of the local riverside barangay.

en.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
en.text: This modern meetinghouse belongs to the Mormon community established in the Cagayan Valley.

en.name: United Methodist Church
en.text: This protestant place of worship hosts Sunday services and community gatherings for the local Methodist congregation.

en.name: Saint Paul the Apostle Parish church
en.text: Dedicated to the Apostle Paul, this large parish church is a focal point of Catholic faith in the region.

en.name: Cabagan Baptist church
en.text: This Baptist church serves as a center for biblical teachings and fellowship in the municipality of Cabagan.

en.name: Catabayungan Ermita Church Cabagan
en.text: This historic-style Christian chapel, known as an ermita, offers a rustic setting for quiet contemplation in Cabagan.

en.name: Casibarag Norte Chapel
en.text: Serving the Casibarag Norte neighborhood, this local Christian chapel is a key spiritual gathering space for nearby residents.

en.name: Cabagan Public Market
en.text: A lively commercial hub in Cabagan where vendors sell a variety of local agricultural goods and meats.
